commits: 62704ea cleanup(analog-placement): step 1 — document every pub item, fold device-touch loops into push_devices, name matched-set member reduction, split environment measurement into free functions

ded8291 cleanup(analog-placement): step 2 — cover every rule's boundaries, empty/single inputs, degenerate geometry and batch hooks; flag duplicate heat rules, zero-spec pulls, SymmetryGroup NaN residuals, empty-set and weightless-net panics

cleanup(analog-placement): step 3 — dedup heat rules globally, zero pull for non-positive specs, SymmetryGroup per-rule residuals, allocation-free orientation and island counts, guard empty MST / weightless nets
flaggedFixed: heat::separations emitted the same (victim, source) rule twice when two matched sets shared a cell (Vec::dedup only drops adjacent duplicates); now sorted and deduplicated globally
HeatSeparation / Isolation cost pulled touching cells apart (cost 1) when min gap <= 0, although satisfied() held; shortfall now uses the real floor over a >= 1 nm divisor
SymmetryGroup::violating_residuals fell back to the trait default (NaN residuals) instead of the per-rule mirror error; now delegates to Vec<Symmetry>
OrientationSet with no members panicked in the Phi check (s[1..] on an empty Vec); fewer than two members is now vacuously met, and residual_of no longer allocates
PlacePerf::mst_len panicked on a net with no cells (pts[0]); now 0 below two cells
PlacePerf::used indexed weights[n] for every item (panic when weights is shorter); now zips weights with items
MatchedSet::ledger_rows panicked on an empty member list (members[0]); now returns nothing
Proximity duplicated Layout::edge_gap in i32/f32; now calls edge_gap
island::components sorted a roots Vec per call; now counts self-roots without allocating
flaggedOpen: LiveEnvironment re-measures every pair on each RuleBatch call (cost, violations, residual, unknown, worst_usage each rebuild all placed rects): O(P * rects) per call, several calls per dp trial; the existing ponytail note names the upgrade (cache unmoved cells via PLC-10's moved set)
environment::well_edge_distance is O(units * wells^2) with an early-exit any() per candidate point; AoS Rect and short early-exit scans make SIMD a poor fit without a layout change (SoA well edges)
MatchedSet ledgers rescan l.power_uw (hot flag) and every powered cell's field per unit per pair; acceptable at current set sizes
PlacePerf::mst_len allocates pts/best/done per call (k <= ~10); left as is
MatchedSet with tol_nm <= 0 yields an inf/NaN coincidence; documented as a precondition, not guarded
A single-member OrientationSet with mixed-axis units now reads as met (doc: fewer than two members is vacuous); previously its Axis check reported 1

seamRequests.change: Let the batch receive the evaluator's moved-cell set (or a per-trial cache handle) so unmoved cells' placed wells/diffusions are reused across cost/violations/residual calls
seamRequests.why: Each RuleBatch method rebuilds every pair's surroundings from scratch; dp calls several per trial

seamRequests.change: Make the fields private behind PlacePerf::new, or store one Vec of per-net rows
seamRequests.why: Public parallel arrays let callers build mismatched lengths; the term now tolerates it but silently ignores nets

risks: No build was run (per rules): step 2 tests and step 3 edits are reasoned against read definitions, not compiled
heat::separations output order changed from source-major to sorted (victim, source); callers only push the Vec as a batch

No SIMD added: every loop in the unit runs over a handful of members, pairs or MST nodes (k <= ~10); the one larger loop (WPE well scan) has early exits on AoS rects, so fearless_simd was not added to the crate
Tests construct Layout literally; a new Layout field from the core-types seam breaks them at compile time (as it does every existing test in the crate)
The relayed user request was about merging branches; locally only main exists, so this unit's work does not touch branches
